description: This file defines an abstract class 'SortDataFormat' for sorting data buffers and a concrete implementation 'KVArraySortDataFormat' for key-value array formats used in Spark's internal sorting mechanisms.

classes.name: SortDataFormat
classes.description: An abstract class providing an interface for sorting arbitrary input buffers of data, including methods for getting keys, swapping, copying, and allocating buffers.

classes.name: KVArraySortDataFormat
classes.description: A concrete subclass of 'SortDataFormat' that sorts arrays of key-value pairs where elements alternate between keys and values, used in Spark's internal data structures.

methods.name: newKey
methods.description: Creates a new mutable key for reuse; default returns null.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the sort key for an element at a given position in the buffer.

methods.name: getKey (with reuse parameter)
methods.description: Returns the sort key for an element, reusing an existing key if possible.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps two elements in the buffer.

methods.name: copyElement
methods.description: Copies a single element from source to destination buffer.

methods.name: copyRange
methods.description: Copies a range of elements from source to destination buffer.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates a buffer capable of holding a specified number of elements.
